name: right_setting_interrupt_then_cancel
description: A realistic voice timeline: one instruction, an interruption while the answer is still playing, a correction that must not re-execute the first action, a progress question that must not claim completion, then a cancel of the same task.
note: Contract regression sample only - never acceptance evidence. No probe in any build can drive this timeline yet: the DEBUG probes accept one PCM (--voice-task-probe / --voice-route-probe) or exactly two (--voice-continuity-probe <progress.pcm> <cancel.pcm>), so a barge-in turn needs a new in-app probe mode and an Xcode rebuild. Until that lands this cassette pins the schema: scripts/acceptance/runner/conversation_driver.py validates it, plans one PCM per turn through synthetic_speech, and degrades only the one- and two-turn cases onto the existing probes (a two-turn script maps to voice_continuity in the documented progress-then-cancel order). This script itself maps to requires_new_probe.
